culprit_citations.quoted_text: Net investment income to average net assets | 10.68 | %

findings.detail: F16 fired even though source shows distribution rate around 9.73% is below the disclosed net investment income yield of 10.68%, so the income-yield/check anchor is wrong.

rationale: F16 compares distribution_rate to income_yield_pct * 1.5. The reviewed metric is a 9.729% distribution rate, while the filing's financial highlights disclose net investment income to average net assets of 10.68% for 2025; the distribution per-share rows show 2.52/2.5203 distributions. Since 9.729% is below 10.68% and well below 1.5x that income yield, the raw source does not support the flag.
